kohs_inventory_debug.lab.cursor_contract: Singleplayer only: verifies native/internal landing, free movement and late releases at GUI 2x/3x/4x. Temporarily changes settings and restores them; no item actions.
kohs_inventory_debug.screen.title: KoHs Inventory Debug
kohs_inventory_debug.screen.hint: Macros work only in a disposable local world. Press MARK, reproduce, then COPY ALL.
kohs_inventory_debug.lab.title: Aggressive Inventory Stress Lab
kohs_inventory_debug.lab.boundary: Normal client input handlers; no direct packets or inventory actions.
kohs_inventory_debug.lab.fast.desc: 24 controlled open/close cycles across practical timings.
kohs_inventory_debug.lab.inv_off.desc: Inventory then offhand at overlapping key timings.
kohs_inventory_debug.lab.off_inv.desc: Offhand then inventory at overlapping key timings.
kohs_inventory_debug.lab.center.desc: Moves the real pointer before each centered opening.
kohs_inventory_debug.lab.latency.desc: Measures p50, p95 and worst opening latency at frame phases.
kohs_inventory_debug.lab.extreme.desc: 0-32 ms alternating presses expose queue and parity failures.
kohs_inventory_debug.lab.jitter.desc: Offsets openings through an entire frame-time window.
kohs_inventory_debug.lab.burst.desc: Sends deterministic 2-5 press bursts and verifies final parity.
kohs_inventory_debug.lab.tornado.desc: Extreme edge-to-edge movement before and during inventory open.
kohs_inventory_debug.lab.chaos.desc: Starts a rapid spiral immediately as the inventory key fires.
kohs_inventory_debug.lab.offhand_race.de: Both input orders at 0-32 ms separation; normal handlers only.
kohs_inventory_debug.lab.soak.desc: Extended mixed opening, pointer and occasional offhand workload.
kohs_inventory_debug.lab.close_hotbar.de: Singleplayer fixture: temporarily seeds a totem and pearls, sends callbacks in one poll, verifies item destinations, then restores the three fixture slots.
kohs_inventory_debug.lab.hold.desc: Checks that OS key repeats cannot toggle the inventory; fresh presses must still work immediately.
kohs_inventory_debug.lab.aggressive.desc: Runs every shortened aggressive battery and produces one summary.
kohs_inventory_debug.lab.pvp_input.desc: Tests fresh presses, pointer targeting and menu layout in the local world.
